Name: MissCoriel's SVE Music Pack
Author: MissCoriel
TagLine: This music pack places Custom Music in Certain Maps from Stardew Valley Expanded.
Description:
SVE is pretty popular.  It is only fitting that it gets the Music Treatment!  7 songs just for SVE are in this pack, all handcrafted by me.

Listen to the Music Pack here!
[soundcloud]https://soundcloud.com/evilpickle-music-dept/sets/expanded-music-pack[/soundcloud]

Installation:

Install [SMAPI](https://smapi.io)  and [Custom Music](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043)

Don't forget to Install [Stardew Valley Expanded](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753)

Put this mod in your mods folder.
